items.quote: Peers observed that Liossa participated in user research with residents on the new app as a team member.
Peers observed that Liossa headed adoption of new technology tools for case officers, setting priorities for several teams.
Liossa set the direction for the decision to decline vendor hospitality during a tender across the public service.
Several respondents noted that Liossa Osford was recognised sector-wide for his leadership of stakeholder consultations for the licensing review.
Direct reports said that Liossa led analytics to guide resource allocation across the department.
Several respondents noted that Liossa set the direction for efforts that helped three direct reports earn promotion across the public service.
Peers observed that Liossa Osford took ownership of a ten-year outlook for where the agency should be heading and steered it to completion.
Liossa championed the transformation of the operating model and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
